images.name: 苔庭绘本
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one landscape 16:9 art-direction concept board for the cozy birdwatching idle game "Little Elsewhere", direction 11 MOSSBOUND STORYBOOK. The reference image is ONLY a spatial environment reference: view through a domestic window, large tree on left, balcony pots and bird feeder in foreground, broad curving river, far town, snow mountains, sky. Preserve these geographic relationships, not the reference interface. REMOVE ALL original interface and the entire bottom dark debug toolbar.

Composition: left approximately 70% is a polished full game HUD concept with the landscape still open and breathable in its center. Right approximately 30% is a large matching OPEN FIELD GUIDE BOOK, curved pages, 2–4 bird specimen cards and selected sparrow detail. Integrate the division organically, like a storybook opening beside a window. This is one complete professional illustrated design direction, not a multi-option collage.

Style: distinctly handcrafted gouache storybook illustration, tiny dry-brush grain, confident drawn contours, botanical wood-carved shapes. UI is built from irregular mossy carved wooden signboards, woven vine stems, sprouting leaf tabs, small mushrooms, delicately painted bird ornaments, parchment book pages with visible torn/deckled edges, seed-shaped and leaf-shaped controls. At least 80% of UI forms must use this material-and-silhouette language, not generic rounded rectangular boxes decorated with a leaf. Large asymmetrical carved title plaque, warm leaf controls along lower window ledge, prominent physical open field guide. Small illustrated sparrow sits on the title plaque. Muted sage, cream, bark brown, dusty ochre, tiny restrained terracotta accents. Gentle luminous daylight, restrained palette, matte paint. Strong stylization immediately visible even as a thumbnail.

Text, only a few clearly readable words: "Little Elsewhere", "Field Guide", "Sparrow", "12/50", "Observe", "Focus". Include simple original bird/leaf/weather symbols. No paragraphs of fake text, no debug labels, no computer window frame. Avoid app-dashboard styling, bland color-swapped panels, oily painting, glossy 3D, plastic, neon, excessive saturation. Render as beautiful finished game UI concept art, not a photograph of objects.

images.name: 立体纸庭
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. One finished landscape 16:9 game-interface concept-art board for "Little Elsewhere". New art direction 12: PAPERCUT CONSERVATORY. The supplied reference is ONLY a geographical composition reference: a window balcony with a large left tree, small plants and bird food dish, a wide naturally curved river, opposite town, layered snowy mountains. Discard every existing panel, all old typography, and especially the entire dark green bottom debug toolbar.

Make the ENTIRE design unmistakably a handcrafted multi-layer paper-cut theatre: clean cut-paper silhouettes, visible paper fibers, folded edges, accordion pleats, delicate offset stacked-paper shadows, flat gouache colors, leafy die-cut buttons, cutout birds, springy folded tabs, scalloped and torn shapes. No conventional screen cards or rounded app panels. A wide irregular cut-paper title banner with a sparrow cutout on its folded corner, paper-leaf weather charms hanging above the scenery, deep layered cloud and mountain cutouts in the window view, and a scalloped folded control ribbon on the balcony ledge. Center-left scenery remains open and spacious.

Composition left about 70% shows the full main-window interface; right about 30% shows the matching field guide as an accordion-folded paper album, visibly constructed from several staggered sheets, with 3 bird cutouts in die-cut windows and one selected sparrow on a raised central page. These zones are integrated as one beautiful professional game UI art-direction proposal. Not a multi-option collage.

Palette: restrained dusty coral, pale mint, cream, greyed teal, small ochre accents. Bright but gentle, large calm color masses and plenty of clear breathing room. Strong physical paper silhouettes and layering are the dominant design language, not a few decorative leaves added to rectangular cards. Title text exactly "Little Elsewhere". Other labels only "Field Guide", "Sparrow", "12/50", "Observe", "Focus"; short and readable, no dense text. Original simple bird, leaf, sun and cloud symbols in cut-paper form.

Avoid oily paint, glossy plastic, photorealistic 3D, generic app dashboard, modern glassmorphism, neon, oversaturated rainbow, unnecessary fine detail, hard computer window chrome. Finished stylized 2D game UI concept art with a soft handcrafted storybook feel.

images.name: 北欧织锦
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one exceptionally distinctive landscape 16:9 game-interface concept illustration for "Little Elsewhere", art direction 13 NORDIC QUILT. Use the reference only for the game world's spatial identity: domestic window and balcony, big tree left, small pots and bird food dish, naturally curved broad river, opposite little town, snowy mountains and open sky. Throw out ALL reference UI and the entire bottom dark debug toolbar.

Art direction: a Scandinavian folk-art fabric-and-embroidery world. The INTERFACE is visibly sewn from natural linen, indigo cloth, cream felt, and muted brick-red patchwork. Real irregular stitches, needlework outlines, visible woven threads, thick hand-embroidered birds and flowers, braided-cord edges, sewn cloth tabs, fabric-covered buttons, a stitched sampler inventory, scalloped textile banners. Flat stylized folk silhouettes rather than smooth vector UI. The entire landscape is coherently simplified into applique shapes and delicate embroidered contour lines, with linen sky and softly stitched water ripples, not photorealism. No glossy 3D. Low saturation, restrained four-color-ish palette: cream, deep indigo, faded brick red, sage. Strong thread texture and bold folk motif placement without visual clutter.

Composition left about 70%: a calm open view through the window with title stitched into an irregular scalloped fabric pennant at upper-left, two small embroidered weather patches at upper-right, restrained main controls sewn into a long patchwork ribbon across the window ledge. Right about 30%: matching field guide resembling a hanging linen sampler/soft cloth book with ribbon bookmarks; 3 bird patches placed in individual embroidered medallions, one selected larger sparrow with leaf/feather stitched motifs. Use a strong asymmetrical sewn silhouette instead of a stack of rectangular app cards. At least 80% of the UI's forms should use cloth construction and actual embroidery language, instantly recognizable at thumbnail scale. This is one professional complete UI art-direction board, not a collage of alternatives or a photograph of a fabric product.

Exact readable labels: "Little Elsewhere", "Field Guide", "Sparrow", "12/50", "Observe", "Focus". Use only these short texts, clean enough to read, matched to embroidered lettering. No fake paragraphs, no debug toolbar, no dashboard, no generic rounded boxes, no glassmorphism, no bright neon, no rainbow palette, no oily painterly rendering. Friendly and quiet, cozy handmade 2D game illustration.
